statements.name: thm:main
statements.text:
\label{thm:main}
For every integer $r\ge4$, there is a constant $c_r>0$ such that every
finite simple $K_r$-free graph $G$ with $n$ vertices and average degree $d\ge2$
satisfies
\[
 \alpha(G)\ge c_r\frac{n\log d}{d}.
\]
